verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents an explicit Organizations feature for realm-level multi-tenancy (create org, unique name per realm) and separately documents identity-provider brokering/federation and realm isolation, which together technically enable per-organization SSO. However the evidence pack never shows domain-verification settings or JIT-provisioning configuration tied specifically to an Organization object—only a generic 'Name' field is mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of org-scoped verified domains, org-to-IdP mapping UI, and JIT user provisioning flow tied to organizations.
